description: This file provides utility functions for interacting with an S3-compatible object storage service, including creating S3 clients and uploading byte data to specified buckets with optional public URL generation.

methods.name: get_s3_client()
methods.description: Creates and configures a boto3 S3 client using project-specific settings.

methods.name: str upload_bytes(bucket: str, key: str, data: bytes, content_type: str)
methods.description: Uploads byte data to a specified S3 bucket and key, returning either a public URL or an s3 URI.

ctags.name: upload_bytes
ctags.pattern: /^def upload_bytes(bucket: str, key: str, data: bytes, content_type: str) -> str:$/
ctags.signature: (bucket: str, key: str, data: bytes, content_type: str)
